research_rationale:
EO 10978 (signed 1961-12-05, John F. Kennedy; 26 FR 11714; filed 1961-12-06 per the Federal Register document line) establishes an award program for contributions to the Export Expansion Program: section 1 establishes it, section 2 directs the Secretary of Commerce to set nomination and granting procedures, section 3 names the President's E Award and the E Certificate of Service, section 4 and 5 describe the two awards, and section 6 allows recipients to issue a pin and use the emblem. I read the held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10978.txt in full (identity matches the register row: number, title, date, signer, page 11714) and the prepared inventory of eight clauses covers every numbered section and subsection of it (the preamble recitals are not operative). The order has no duration, condition or deadline. The bounded machine searches were read for coverage: the U.S. Code search (release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 are not reflected), the eCFR search (as of 2026-10-14) and the Federal Register disposition-note search (6941 catalog records) each returned zero hits naming this order, so no amendment, revocation or supersession is recorded in any of them. The held texts that cite the order's number are the 1989 codification snapshot, the order itself and a 2011 Federal Register notice from the Department of Commerce, which describes the E Award Program as established by the order; none ends it. No later instrument is held that affects the order, so the legal predicate for continuation is the held original read with those bounded searches (the original_plus_bounded_search route); this is evidence of absence of an ending in the searched sources, not a positive 2026 source, and I state it so.
